title: Code for: Integrative Single-Cell Transcriptomics and Explainable AI for Disease Mechanism and Biomarker Discovery in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
description: Original and sample-aware analysis code and results for a single-cell RNA-seq and explainable machine-learning (XGBoost + SHAP) study of invasive versus non-invasive MDA-MB-231 triple-negative breast cancer cells (GEO GSE329526). Includes sample-level differential expression, sample-grouped cross-validation, held-out SHAP and GSEA. Input data are public and not included.
